cases.title: CDFW typed at an inspection opening that sits on pipe ends places a floor waste (no 'Civil record changed while you picked' refusal, no rollback)
cases.plan_item: CDFW floor waste, endpoint-claim route (triage group R3; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-147
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. BUG-147 (CDFW / CDSOURCE rolled back on a duplicate AGI tag via endpoint claims) is the nearest open entry; its text names a rollback, while the line seen here is the refusal "A nearby pipe's Civil record changed while you picked", so the desk decides whether BUG-147 owns it or a new bug does. No entry for that exact line was found in BUG_CARPARK.md on 25 Oct 2026.
cases.expected: CDFW with the point 51777.389,-46593.223 (inspection opening 108F55, on pipe ends) prints "Floor waste placed." and adds exactly one FLOOR WASTE block and one text FW; it does not print "A nearby pipe's Civil record changed", "rolled back" or "more than one source"; one U takes the floor waste back. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The claim of a pipe end by a block runs against the real pits, pipes and tagged blocks of the live drawing.
not_automated: CDSOURCE (named in BUG-147 and BUG-132) is not run. Which blocks carry the AGI tag is not read. The typed point is not a mouse pick: whether a real mouse pick at the same place behaves the same is not driven.
